drhp.business: The Company operates premium men's grooming and lifestyle services in India under the globally recognised heritage brand Truefitt & Hill, delivering salon/barbershop services through highly skilled professionals at premium locations. Alongside its physical salon network it sells premium grooming products through leading online marketplaces and a direct-to-consumer platform, building an omnichannel presence. Its stated customer proposition is service quality, personalised experience and a trusted international brand for the premium grooming consumer.

litigation.note: The Directors' Report states that during the year no significant and material orders were passed by regulators, courts or tribunals impacting the going concern status or future operations. No application was made during FY 2025-26 by or against the Company and no proceedings are pending under the Insolvency and Bankruptcy Code 2016. The Company has not made any one-time settlement with any of its lenders. The Statutory Auditors' Report and the Secretarial Audit Report are stated to be devoid of any reservation, qualification or adverse remark, and no frauds were reported under Section 143(12). No amounts are disclosed in the routed text.
